log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 2 gate (packet )

body.p: For the owner. Only the first is a gate box.

item.p: Tag 0.2.0. Every other box is ticked (). CHANGELOG.md says "unreleased"; docs/RELEASE.md lists the steps (tag, npm name sxml-js while sxml is taken on npm).

WebAssembly budgets (Proposed): sxml.wasm is 1,865,152 bytes stripped and 647,721 gzipped against 2,000,000 / 700,000 (7 % left); the CLI with XQuery 3,480,962 / 780,893 against 3,700,000 / 820,000. Phases 3 and 4 are likely to pass them: confirm higher budgets, or ask for optional modules (XQuery and XSLT grammars, Unicode and collation tables).
XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default (Proposed, ): no (write the declaration, as QT4 expects) or keep yes.
Provisional headers (): xquery.h and xslt.h may change in a minor release until the Phase 3 and 4 gates. Accept, or declare them stable now.
CI (): still local only; macOS, Windows and MSVC have not been built since the Phase 0 gate.
